description: Patient occupied a private suite billed at INR 7500 per day for 4 days. The daily rate exceeds the INR 5000 limit, resulting in a deterministic excess room rent deduction of INR 10000.

source.quote: Executive Suite Room Charges: 4 days @ INR 7500.00 per day = INR 30000.00.

calculation_steps: Daily excess: INR 7500 - INR 5000 = INR 2500 per day.
Total excess room rent deduction: 4 days * INR 2500/day = INR 10000.00.
expected_findings.explanation: Daily room rent of INR 7500 exceeds the policy cap of INR 5000 per day by INR 2500 per day across 4 days.

source.quote: Section 2.2 (Room Rent Daily Limit): The maximum eligible room and boarding expense covered by the insurer is INR 5000 per day of hospitalization. Any room rent charges incurred in excess of INR 5000 per day are non-payable by the insurer and shall be borne entirely by the insured person.
